name: Evocation
description: Completely restores Mana at the cost of your turn; 7 combat turn cooldown.
fullManaLine: You reach for the feelings and memories of Shizuki. The Astral light answers, takes one look at your completely full Mana, and quietly fades away.
successLines: For a moment, you remember a place you've never been. Shizuki was probably there.
A distant giggle echoes through the Astral Sea. Your Mana returns. Your questions do not get answered.
For just a moment, the Astral Sea feels strangely familiar.
You remember Shizuki saying something encouraging. Unfortunately, you cannot remember what it was.
A faint memory of white hair drifts through your thoughts before disappearing into starlight.
A familiar warmth fills your chest. So does an unreasonable amount of Mana.
For a heartbeat, you hear the distant sound of someone saying, "You'll probably need this."
Somewhere far away, you could swear you hear Shizuki humming. The sound disappears as quickly as it came.
You remember the first time the Astral Sea stretched out before you. Somehow, it feels even larger in your memory.
A memory of shimmering currents passes through your mind. You follow them for a moment and return feeling strangely refreshed.
You remember a Jellyfish looking at you with absolute determination. You're still not entirely sure how something without a face managed that.
You remember the soft glow of Moonlit Reef. For a moment, the same light seems to shimmer around you.
You remember the first creature you ever fought in the Astral Sea. You'd like to think you've gotten better since then.
You remember finding a Berry when you desperately needed one. This is somehow almost as comforting.
You remember watching starlight ripple across the water. The memory ripples through you now.
You remember one of your journeys through the Astral Sea. Not the important parts, apparently. Mostly the part where you got lost.
A memory of distant bells drifts through your thoughts. You don't remember where you heard them, but the Astral Sea seems to.
You remember standing somewhere quiet between adventures, listening to the currents pass by. For a moment, you're there again.
You remember the supervising leaf staring at you over its clipboard. Somehow, this inspires you to keep going.
You remember the tiny Fae rushing to patch you up after a particularly questionable decision. There were a lot of leaves involved.
You remember an Astral Charge stubbornly attached to someone's forehead. Some memories are more useful than others.
You remember the rush of discovering somewhere new. That same excitement flickers through you again.
You remember collecting a Travel Note and wondering who had been there before you. The thought still follows you.
You remember a moment when the journey felt impossible. Then you remember that you kept going anyway.
A dozen little memories of the Astral Sea surface all at once: glowing reefs, strange creatures, distant stars, and at least one extremely bad decision.
You let your journey through the Astral Sea wash over you. Every strange encounter, every discovery, and every memory becomes Astral light.
